svg.title: Greek Theogony
svg.desc: A visual map of ancient Greek gods, collective divine races, immediate families and selected parent traditions.

text.tspan: Each box takes its own group's colour. An
outline surrounds the children of one parent,
drawn in that parent's group colour. Where two
outlines overlap, the figures inside share both
parents. Zeus, for example, sits where Cronus's
